study_identification_part.si4_title: Capturing the Individual Deviations From Normative Models of Brain Structure for Depression Diagnosis and Treatment

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Estimate normative models of regional gray matter volume (GMV) in healthy adults and use individual deviations (z-scores) to aid depression diagnosis and to identify treatment-related latent structural factors.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: The normative model is trained on HCP and REST-meta-MDD healthy controls.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: "we downloaded phenotypic data and MRI T1-weighted data from the Human Connectome Project ... and REST-meta-MDD Project ..."

rci2_hc_n.reason: The normative model was constructed using HC participants from both HCP (510) and REST-meta-MDD (229), totaling 510 + 229 = 739 participants. This is explicitly confirmed in the text when describing the normative modeling.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: Briefly, for each brain region, we estimated an age-related normative model with datasets II and III (n = 510 + 229 = 739)
rci2_hc_n.location: Shao2024.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Normative Modeling and Individual Deviations, Line 57

rci3_hc_age.reason: Means/SD for HCP (29.19±3.50; 22–36) and REST-meta-MDD (39.34±15.66; 18–65) are reported; combined mean/SD computed as weighted mean and pooled SD; min/max from reported ranges.
rci3_hc_age.supporting_text: "mean age, 29.19 ± 3.50 years ..." and "mean age, 39.34 ± 15.66 years ..."; "age range, 22–36 years" and "age range, 18–65 years"

rci4_hc_sex.reason: Female counts are given per dataset (302 in HCP; 156 in REST-meta-MDD); totals and percentages computed.
rci4_hc_sex.supporting_text: "510 HC ... (mean age, 29.19 ± 3.50 years; 302 women) and 229 HC ... (mean age, 39.34 ± 15.66 years; 156 women)."

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: All datasets used T1-weighted structural MRI for GMV estimation.
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: "phenotypic data and MRI T1-weighted data ..."; "T1 images were segmented ... to obtain the gray matter map"

caa2_diseases_studied.reason: Patients are described as depressed per DSM; study focuses on depression diagnosis and treatment.
caa2_diseases_studied.supporting_text: "... diagnosis and treatment of depression ..."; "According to the DSM ... depression patients were diagnosed ..."

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Individualized deviations from normative GMV maps improve depression recognition over raw GMV and reveal latent treatment-related structural factors.
